name: Beyond the Chrysalis
assumptions:
Passive "Dance of Wings Unbound" is not modelled yet: the weapon contributes only its base ATK and secondary stat. R1 text: Each time the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they gain one of the following three effects in sequence:
Winds of Devotion: Increases the equipping character's CRIT DMG by 56% for 10s;
Winds of Defiance: Increases Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by the equipping character by 36% for 10s; and
Winds of Plenty: Regenerates 5 Elemental Energy for the equipping character. Up to 5 Elemental Energy can be regenerated in this way every 4s.
The aforementioned effects are removed and the sequence is reset when the equipping character leaves the field.
Obtain method is a guess from rarity and has not been verified in a source page.
Base ATK and secondary stat are from genshin-db only (not cross-checked in a second source).
